newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-METS TRADE BROGNA TO PHILS, DIPOTO TO ROCKIES.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-METS TRADE BROGNA TO PHILS, DIPOTO TO ROCKIES.

text.p: The New York Mets traded first baseman Rico Brogna to the Philadelphia Phillies for pitchers Ricardo Jordan and Toby Borland, and also sent right-hander Jerry DiPoto to the Colorado Rockies for pitcher Armando Reynoso Wednesaday.

Brogna, 26, was supposed to be the first baseman of the future for the Mets, but appeared in only 55 games this season due to a shoulder injury. He batted .255 with seven homers and 30 RBI. He had a breakthrough season in 1995, hitting .289 with 22 home runs and 76 RBI in 134 games.
Borland and Jordan are relievers. Borland, 27, made a team-high 69 appearances for Philadelphia in 1996, posting a 7-3 record and 4.17 ERA in 90-2/3 innings.
